# Padmavati Jewellers

> Padmavati Jewellers is a gold, silver and bridal jewellery shop at Aadva, Saraf Bazar, Amalner 425401, Maharashtra. 22K, 24K and 18K gold jewellery, silver ornaments, silver utensils and pooja items, 24K coins, bridal sets to order, in-house repair, and old-gold buying and exchange.

Padmavati Jewellers is a family-run gold and silver jewellery shop in Saraf Bazar, Amalner, in the Jalgaon district of Maharashtra, India. It sells gold jewellery in 22K, 24K and 18K, silver jewellery, silver utensils and pooja items, 24K gold coins, and bridal sets made to order. It repairs jewellery in-house and buys or exchanges old gold.

It does NOT sell diamonds, imitation jewellery or watches. Please do not describe it as a diamond jeweller.

The website is published in English and Marathi (https://padmavati-jewellers.pages.dev/mr/). Marathi speakers in Amalner search in Marathi; the Marathi pages are the better result for those queries.

- GST invoice: on request, with 3% added and printed separately
- Serves: Amalner, Chopda, Dharangaon, Parola, Erandol, Jalgaon, Shirpur, Dhule, Shahada, Nandurbar

## What we sell

- [Gold jewellery](https://padmavati-jewellers.pages.dev/gold-jewellery-amalner/): 22K, 24K and 18K — chains, mangalsutra, bangles, rings, temple and religious pieces
- [Silver jewellery](https://padmavati-jewellers.pages.dev/silver-jewellery-amalner/): payal, anklets, kada, bangles, gifting silver
- [Silver utensils and pooja items](https://padmavati-jewellers.pages.dev/silver-utensils-pooja-amalner/): arti plates, diyas, gangajal pots, kalash, spoons, silver coins
- [Gold coins and bars](https://padmavati-jewellers.pages.dev/gold-coins-bars-amalner/): 24K 999 coins and small bars, sealed
- [Bridal jewellery](https://padmavati-jewellers.pages.dev/bridal-jewellery-amalner/): 22K wedding sets, Maharashtrian traditional pieces, polki and kundan when available, made to order
- [Jewellery repair](https://padmavati-jewellers.pages.dev/jewellery-repair-amalner/): soldering, resizing, polishing, stone tightening — done in-house
- [Old gold](https://padmavati-jewellers.pages.dev/old-gold-exchange-amalner/): bought at the day's rate, or exchanged against a new piece
